message.content:
**Request to VirusTotal API**

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/graphs?query=ip:145.34.45.56&cursor=cursor_b&limit=8
```

**Headers**

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `x-apikey` | `api_key_2` |
| `Accept` | `application/json` |

> **Note:**  
> - The `cursor` query parameter is set to `cursor_b` as requested.  
> - The `limit` query parameter is set to `8`.  
> - If your API key requires a bearer token style header, replace the `x-apikey` header with `Authorization: Bearer api_key_2`.

**What this does**

This request will return up to 8 graph objects that contain the IP address **145.34.45.56**. The response will include each graph’s unique ID (e.g., `"id": "graph-123456"`), which you can extract from the JSON payload.
